content: {"praised": ["Workouts are super easy and suitable for older people.", "Workbook helps track progress and stay focused.", "Routines are excellent and well divided by body part.", "Program includes 30‑minute sessions for each DVD.", "Easy to follow for beginners and those not in great shape."], "criticized": ["Music is terrible and distracting.", "Minimal instructions and unclear prompts.", "Voice‑over not synchronized with exercises.", "Production quality makes audio hard to hear.", "Exercise one leg and not the other, uneven routine."]}
